definitions.full: H5572. seneh סְנֶה noun masculine Exod 3:2 a thorny bush , perhaps black-berry bush (compare Löw No. 219 ; rubus fruticosus Linn.; Aramaic סַנְיָא , thorn-bush , Assyrian sinû , Meissn ZA vi. 293 blackberry bush (Meissner thinks Aramaic ׳ס loan-word from this); Arabic senna , Lane 1449 ); — absolute ׳ס 3:2 (twice in verse); 3:4 , מְנֶ֑ה 3:2 ; 3:3 (all E) Deut 33:16 (akin to E).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to prick ;
